findings.reason: extending reset_to_status in imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py to accept the path prefixes and render the clause itself (with reset.py:268's renderer) turns the code-reset node into one owner change plus one call-site deletion instead of a copied block, and removes the parameter-name duplication the plan otherwise perpetuates.
findings.text: §14 adds the prefix-scoped reset by copying the paths command's four-line block (spec lookup, render_path_prefix_clause, reset_to_status with extra_filter/extra_params) into code.py "as the paths command does"; that wiring already exists inline in three CLI call sites (paths.py:246–257, signals.py:227, code.py:200) and forces each caller to know both the prefix renderer and the `root_prefixes`/`prefixes` parameter-name convention, so a fourth hand-rolled copy will drift from the renderer's contract.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the sections that add machinery hide substantial behaviour behind one interface: pending_embed_predicate renders one pending-embedding fragment for three call sites, ensure_vector_indexes is the sole composer of vector-index DDL, render_chunk_source is one resolver over the owning HAS_CHUNK edge, and render_path_prefix_clause is one prefix renderer for seven claims plus the scoped reset.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14's code-reset change reproduces the paths command's hand-rolled reset wiring at a third CLI call site instead of extending the owner reset_to_status, which already owns the filter contract.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no surface to any family (it uses the existing --root, --path-prefix and --reset-to, and adds no public definition, MCP view or refusal family), so there is nothing it must name as retired or merged.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the existing mechanism for each change it proposes (render_path_prefix_clause, seed_facility_roots, reset_to_status, CODE_RESET_SPECS) and I confirmed each exists at the named owner; §14 proposes no new subsystem.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §6 explicitly declines to add a preflight command and extends check_tool/check_all_tools instead; §14's two code changes extend the existing reset machinery (reset_to_status already takes extra_filter/extra_params) rather than wrapping it in a new layer.
